topic: 帆布鞋沾泥後，先拍鞋底邊與鞋口
conflict: 單一灰卡仍擋住右鞋鞋口，鞋底邊與內裡無法在第一秒同時看清。
single_action: 同一隻完整成人手只把軌道上的單一卡片向右滑出畫面；兩隻帆布鞋與後方固定止擋全程不動。
payoff: 卡片離開後，鞋口、鞋底邊與原始泥痕同時清楚可見。
cta: 拍全貌與兩個局部，點個人檔案連結加 LINE 先詢問。
first_frame_direction: 固定直式中近景；前景是完整兩隻帆布鞋、單一卡片與完整五指手，中景是獨立淺軌與固定止擋，中後景保留金屬架與有來源的窗光；鞋帶、鞋舌、接觸面與陰影可追蹤。
grok_motion_prompt: Create one continuous 6-second 9:16 photorealistic Taiwanese laundry inspection-counter shot. First frame: exactly two faded-navy canvas sneakers remain stationary on one grey mat, one fixed low wooden heel stop behind them, and exactly one blank grey card captured by one separate shallow metal rail on a small tray in front of the right shoe. The card partly blocks the right shoe collar but never touches the shoe. One complete adult hand and wrist are broadly visible holding only the card with five fingers. One dominant action only: slide the single card laterally right until it fully clears the shoe, withdraw the same hand, then hold. Preserve exactly two stationary shoes, one stop, one rail, one card, one hand, mud marks, laces, tongues, soles and eyelets. Realistic weight, inertia, grip and contact shadows; fixed restrained camera. No close-up finger detail, no extra hands, no duplicate object, no morphing, no geometry changes, no penetration, no cleaning transformation, no readable text, no logo, no watermark, no generated audio.

cta: 拍正面、拉鍊邊與內袋縫線，點個人檔案連結加 LINE 先詢問。
